args.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW KFB claymation INK BLOB MONSTER six-character sheet, Classic Maya-inspired court, workshop and market family. Actual input images are bounded STYLE references for organic goo anatomy, rounded plasticine volume and handcrafted props. New cast and outfit designs. Exactly SIX unique complete upright figures, 3 columns x 2 rows, TRUE transparent PNG, landscape 1536x1024. All six at comparable substantial scale, each entire silhouette including prop and droplets inside its own cell with 32px outer and cell gutters. No scenelet, scenery, floor, shadow discs, lettering, logo, panel border or connecting effects.
Historical material inspiration: short cotton-like cream wraps with brick red and jade-green accents, carved jade bead collar, restrained woven headbands; ink faces clear, no giant feather towers. Whimsical absurd-surreal everyday roles and satirical personalities across time. Museum-evoking craft cues interpreted as fictional multiverse game characters, not literal reconstructions. Each whole figure is a continuous short round DARK CHARCOAL ink splat with subtle plum shading, thick asymmetrical soft goo lobes and tiny ink hands; face directly sculpted into ink, bare rounded goo base, no humanoid legs or long torso. Clothing is a small accessory wrapping the blob; keep dominant organic ink mass. All eyes WHITE/IVORY sclera, RED iris, BLACK pupil, fully filled DARK sculpted lids. Soft tactile fingerprints, rich softly modeled clay, restrained satin light from upper left; no luminous lavender/white outline, fabric fibers on goo or liquid chrome. Rounded chunky tools, very few clear bold props. Teeth sit INSIDE mouth behind lips, never attached below/outside lip. Wide range of face shapes, gaze, posture and emotions; independent acting, no six identical grins. Two female-read characters as specified below. Original references must not cause copied military hats, wings, eyepatches or veteran insignia. Top row Court Circle, bottom row Market Circle, but every actor individually usable with independent props. Row-major:
1. Male-read panicked calendar keeper: tall wobbling droplet, wide uneven eyes, clenched interior two-tooth mouth. Simple prop: small folded bark-paper-like booklet with simple dot marks. Personality: Can schedule anything except an interruption.
2. Male-read suspicious jade artisan: wide uneven puddle-shaped base with upright face, narrow sideways eyes, sealed crooked lip. Simple prop: small green polished bead and blunt cord drill. Personality: Thinks every perfect stone is concealing a flaw.
3. Female-read delighted cacao steward: round generous bean, one eye squeezed joyfully, open sideways laugh with uneven interior teeth. Simple prop: tall clay cacao cup with a thick swirled foam top and a small pouring lip. Personality: Maintains morale one carefully guarded serving at a time.
4. Male-read indignant courtyard mason: squared squat blob, one huge offended eye and one heavy lid, tiny pursed pout. Simple prop: short stone square and compact basket of smooth limestone blocks. Personality: Believes a crooked step can undermine public confidence.
5. Male-read overconfident court athlete: lean curved ink splat, smug eyes aimed down, narrow closed grin. Simple prop: one small heavy rubber ball held on a padded belt at belly. Personality: Regards every bounce as applause.
6. Female-read weary textile maker: broad teardrop, sleepy opposite-direction gaze, sagging closed mouth. Simple prop: small folded patterned cloth and chunky wooden weaving shuttle. Personality: Can repair a social fabric but charges extra for certainty.
Use new silhouettes and expressive peak acting, with charm, wear and offbeat cartoon character. Keep clearly separate generous transparent gutters and complete large figures. No extra actors or decorative loose props.
